flashcards.back: Truly understanding both the creator and the creation.
The field is the body with mind, ego, senses and their objects; the knower of the field is the eternal Spirit.
Humility, modesty, nonviolence, forgiveness, honesty, service to the guru, purity, steadiness, self-control, absence of ego.
Constant reflection on the pain in birth, old age, disease and death is listed among the marks of knowledge.
Only by parables: without senses yet perceiving through all, inside and outside all beings, near and far.
Spirit and material nature are both beginningless. Body and senses come from nature; pleasure and pain from the soul's tie to it.

flashcards.front: What causes birth in good and evil wombs? (13.21)
flashcards.back: Purusha's attachment to the modes of nature, out of ignorance caused by past Karma.
One who sees the same eternal Lord dwelling equally in all mortal beings.
Selfless service, knowledge, devotion, meditation and surrender, seen with the eye of Self-knowledge.

options.B: The body, with mind, senses and their objects

quiz.why: The Spirit is the knower of the field.

quiz.text: Which is listed as a mark of true knowledge (13.7-8)?
quiz.why: Knowledge is a way of being, not information.

quiz.text: How can the Supreme be described?
quiz.why: He is inside and outside all, near and far.
Purusha and Prakriti have no beginning.

options.B: One who sees the same Lord in all beings

quiz.text: Which is NOT one of the five paths of 13.34?
